basic_details.short_information: District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, Rampurhat Health District, West Bengal, has invited applications for 12 posts in 4 roles under Advt No. DHFWS/RPH/DPMU/4160. The posts include General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) (FRU), Medical Officer (XV Finance Commission Health Grants), Medical Officer (RKSK), Medical Officer (NUHM). The online application is open from 13 November 2026 to 26 November 2026.

After registration, pay the fee using application ID and Date of Birth by net banking, UPI or credit/debit card by 23/11/2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Rampurhat Health District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 26 November 2026. Applications opened on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Rampurhat Health District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 vacancies: 5 General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) (FRU), 4 Medical Officer (XV Finance Commission Health Grants), 1 Medical Officer (RKSK), 2 Medical Officer (NUHM).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Rampurhat Health District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General Caste: Rs.100. Reserved Category: Rs.50.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years, Lower Age Limit 21 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: Reserved candidates As per govt. norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.60,000 ( Rupees Sixty Thousand Only) for General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) (FRU), Rs.60,000 ( Rupees Sixty Thousand Only) for Medical Officer (XV Finance Commission Health Grants), Rs.60,000 ( Rupees Sixty Thousand Only) for Medical Officer (RKSK), Rs.60,000 ( Rupees Sixty Thousand Only) for Medical Officer (NUHM).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS from any Medical College; registration under West Bengal Medical Council. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate should be a permanent resident of West Bengal. Candidate should be able to read, write and speak in Bengali. Candidate must be registered under West Bengal Medical Council. All qualifications must be from a recognized institute/University.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Caste/Disability/EWS certificates not issued by competent authorities of West Bengal on or before the last date of online application will not be accepted. Candidates found ineligible at any stage will not be called for subsequent stages.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Academics (MBBS) score - 85 marks. Interview of shortlisted candidates - 15 marks. Academics (MBBS): 85 marks. Interview: 15 marks; only shortlisted candidates called.
